defects_found_and_fixed.fix: test_a_checksum_mismatch_prevents_readiness now skips when the artifact is absent; a missing file and a mismatched checksum are different claims
defects_found_and_fixed.impact: a checkout without the ONNX file saw a failure, not a skip

defects_found_and_fixed.impact: passed in a working checkout where the directory exists, failed in a fresh clone, which is where the check matters

fail_closed_observed: Before the artifact was mounted the container answered /health 200 alive and /ready false with model_artifact_present false. Liveness and readiness are genuinely distinct, and the service refuses to declare itself ready without a verified model rather than serving without one.
manual_prerequisites: Docker daemon access (this environment required sudo).
AWS credentials able to read the model artifact bucket, for step 6.
Network access for the clone, the package index and the artifact fetch.
method: A new directory, a fresh git clone from the public remote, and a new virtualenv. No existing environment, build cache, generated file, local model copy or image corpus was reused, and no machine-specific path was relied on.

policy_fingerprint_reproduced.note: Identical to the fingerprint the deployed AWS service reports, so the clean clone reproduces the same decision policy, not merely a working build.

steps.detail: git clone of the public remote into an empty directory

requirements-competition.txt installed cleanly, but test collection then failed on two modules: starlette's TestClient needs an HTTP transport and none was pinned. The working environment had acquired httpx incidentally, so no earlier run had exercised a genuinely fresh install. httpx==0.28.1 is now pinned - the version every recorded test result was produced under.
770 passed, 141 skipped, 0 failed with no model artifact present
aws s3 cp from the model artifact bucket, as documented in PHASE4_AWS_DEPLOYMENT.md
steps.step: obtain model through the documented mechanism

steps.detail: 24 build steps, image agrivision:cleanroom built from the clone
model artifact mounted read-only at MODEL_DIR=/opt/agrivision/model, in-memory persistence, non-root user
ready true, OpenCV 5.0.0, model artifact present and verified, model loaded
NORMAL -> COMPLETE with the model invoked in 259 ms; SEVERE_BLUR -> REQUEST_RECAPTURE with the model skipped in 68 ms
9 and 7 step records retrieved by run id

artifact_independent.note: What a contributor or judge without the ONNX file sees. Explicit skips, no failures.

remaining_skip_reasons: research checkpoint not present locally (1 test)
licensed corpus imagery not present in this checkout (1 test)

third_party_limitation: A judge cloning the public repository cannot obtain the model artifact unaided: model.onnx is gitignored, the S3 object is private, and the alternative documented route re-exports it from a V2 research checkpoint that is also not in the repository. The artifact-independent suite runs for anyone; the container does not. This is stated rather than implied, and closing it means either publishing the artifact or shipping a credential-free fetch path.
